short: Elon Musk's AI company, maker of the Grok models, now folded into SpaceX as SpaceXAI.
definition: xAI is an AI company founded in 2023 by Elon Musk that develops the Grok family of large language models. In 2025 it acquired the social platform X (formerly Twitter), integrating Grok with X's real-time data, and built one of the largest reported clusters of GPUs (the specialized chips used to train AI) to support training. In February 2026, SpaceX acquired xAI in an all-stock deal, and the combined AI unit was rebranded SpaceXAI in July 2026, continuing Grok's development as part of Musk's broader space and AI ambitions.
